purpose: V7 second-pass decode-step comparison with text-free, metadata-selected concatenation inputs.
scope_note: All components were already tested in the old 2,506-record experiment; these concatenations are additional confirmations, not unseen data. Selection did not use transcripts, references, gold entities, ASR outputs, or V7 outcomes.

decode_step_change.only_variable: second-pass entity replay ASR decode step; first pass remains 2 seconds

selection.algorithm: For each library_key, exclude IDs in frozen_test_plan.json and all components of the preflight plan; sort by SHA-256 of UTF-8 `replay-step-v7:<id>` ascending, ID as tie-break. News takes 24, other libraries take 8 each.
selection.news_cohort_rule: At least 6 negatives remained; selected 6 negatives and 18 positives by the same fixed hash, then assigned 2 negatives + 6 positives per group.
selection.parameter_selection_basis: All selections use metadata and fixed hashes only; no case selected because an ASR output was good or bad.

library_policy: Use each full existing library_key snapshot unchanged; no vocabulary shrinking, per-domain threshold tuning, or entity mutation.
